pey: abbr. photoelectric yield 光电子产额
peyman: [人名] [南方英格兰人姓氏] 佩曼来源于Pay,含义是“佩伊之仆”(servant of Pay)
peyote: [医] 拍约他, 仙人球膏(制自墨西哥仙人球的麻醉剂)

n a small spineless globe-shaped cactus; source of mescal buttons
n the hallucinatory alkaloid that is the active agent in mescal buttons
peyotes: 仙人掌的一种( peyote的名词复数 )
